{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

print("Checking for exact '999999.99' in revenue:")
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Check for any revenue value that contains '999999.99' as substring
print("\nChecking for any revenue containing '999999.99':")
print(df[df['revenue'].str.contains('999999.99', na=False)])"}
